trial_title: Rituximab in Children and Adolescents With Relapsed and Refractory B-Cell NHL/L3ALL
brief_summary: This is a multicentric phase II study of Mabthera (rituximab) in children and adolescents with relapsed and refractory B-cell NHL/L3ALL. The primary objective is to determine the response rate of Rituximab as single agent in relapsed or refractory Burkitt lymphoma, L3 acute leukemia, large B-cell lymphoma and non subclassified aggressive B-cell NHL

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically or cytologically proven B-cell malignancies, either Burkitt NHL or L3 ALL or large B-cell lymphoma or aggressive B-cell NHL, with the exception of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in the mediastinum.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a confirmed diagnosis of Burkitt's lymphoma, which is a B-cell malignancy.
There is no information provided about immunohistochemistry results, specifically regarding CD20 positivity.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient's tumor tissue demonstrate ≥30% CD20 positive B cells as determined by immunohistochemistry?

eligibility_table.criterion: Measurable (at least one bi-dimensionally measurable lesion) or evaluable (bone marrow, bone involvement) disease in progression since the last evaluation
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a cardiac mass consistent with Burkitt's lymphoma, indicating measurable disease.

eligibility_table.criterion: First relapsed or refractory disease after LMB or BFM protocol, except the isolated CNS relapses
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's treatment history does not specify if they have had a first relapse or refractory disease after LMB or BFM protocol.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a first relapse or refractory disease after completing the LMB or BFM protocol, excluding any isolated CNS relapses?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 44 years old and has a life expectancy greater than 4 weeks.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Karnofsky performance status score greater than 30?

eligibility_table.criterion: Adequate hepatic, renal and cardiac functions
eligibility_table.justification: There is no specific information provided regarding the patient's hepatic, renal, and cardiac functions.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a serum creatinine level ≤1.2 mg/dL, a total bilirubin level ≤1.2 mg/dL, and an ejection fraction ≥50%?

eligibility_table.criterion: Wash out of 3 weeks in case of recent chemotherapy
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on whether the patient has had recent chemotherapy and the required washout period.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient completed their last chemotherapy treatment at least 3 weeks prior to enrollment in the trial?

eligibility_table.criterion: Complete initial work-up within 8 days prior to treatment
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the completion of the initial work-up within the specified timeframe.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient completed all required initial work-up tests within 8 days prior to the start of rituximab treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Able to comply with scheduled follow-up and with management of toxicity
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on the patient's ability to comply with follow-up and management of toxicity.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Can the patient attend all scheduled follow-up appointments and manage any potential toxicity associated with rituximab treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Written inform consent form from adult patients and from parents and legal guardians for minor children
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the written informed consent.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has written informed consent been obtained from the patient's legal guardian for participation in the trial?

eligibility_table.criterion: Active viral infection, especially chronic hepatitis B
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of viral encephalitis/meningitis, but there is no specific mention of an active viral infection or chronic hepatitis B.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a positive hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) test result?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of Burkitt's lymphoma but there is no indication of previous salvage therapy for relapse.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient received at least one prior salvage therapy for relapse of B-cell NHL or L3ALL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Prior or current history of severe allergy
eligibility_table.justification: There is no documented history of severe allergies in the patient's profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented history of severe allergic reactions, such as anaphylaxis, to any medications or substances?

eligibility_table.criterion: Primary large B-cell lymphoma of the mediastinum
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has primary cardiac lymphoma, not primary large B-cell lymphoma of the mediastinum.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a confirmed diagnosis of primary large B-cell lymphoma of the mediastinum based on imaging and histopathological evaluation?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient's history does not indicate an isolated CNS relapse; the primary concern is cardiac involvement.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a documented isolated CNS relapse of B-cell NHL or L3ALL within the last 12 months?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Active viral infection, especially chronic hepatitis B
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: previous salvage therapy for relapse
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Prior or current history of severe allergy
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Primary large B-cell lymphoma of the mediastinum
LOW INCLUSION MATCH: only 3 of 11 inclusion criteria met
